title: Filing, Withdrawal and Refiling Terms by Tier — Appeals and Grievances Schedule
content:
**Filing terms by tier — Appeals and Grievances**

Every Appeals and Grievances case is filed against a deadline counted in calendar days from a date on the subject record. The terms of filing, withdrawing and filing again are set per tier:

- *Filing deadline*: calendar days after the initial determination date within which the case must be received.
- *Deadline counted from*: the record date the filing deadline is counted from.
- *Deadline measured by*: which date of the filing is compared with the deadline.
- *Late filing with good cause*: whether a late filing is accepted when good cause for the delay is documented.
- *Good cause examples*: documented circumstances accepted as good cause for a late filing or for nonpayment.
- *Telephone filing*: whether the case may be opened by telephone rather than in writing.
- *Filing fee*: USD charged to file the case.
- *Withdrawal*: whether the appellant may withdraw before a decision.
- *Filing again after withdrawal*: whether and until when a withdrawn case may be filed again.

| Tier | Filing deadline (calendar days) | Deadline counted from | Deadline measured by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | 90 | the Explanation of Benefits date of the line | the date the region receives the filing |
| Beneficiary Grievance | 90 | the date of the event complained of | the date the region receives the filing |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | 90 | the Explanation of Benefits date of the line | the date the region receives the filing |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | 90 | the disenrollment or termination date | the date the region receives the filing |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 90 | the denial decision date | the date the region receives the filing |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 3 | the denial decision date | the date the region receives the filing |

| Tier | Late filing with good cause | Telephone filing | Filing fee (USD) | Withdrawal | Filing again after withdrawal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | accepted | no | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |
| Beneficiary Grievance | not accepted | yes | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | accepted | no | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | not accepted | no | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | accepted | no | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | not accepted | yes | 0.00 | allowed | only within the original filing deadline |

**Good cause examples (the same list on every tier):** hospitalization of the beneficiary or sponsor; deployment of the sponsor; a declared natural disaster; a region billing or mailing error; a death in the immediate family. The list is the same for all six tiers, but it serves a late filing only on the tiers whose schedule accepts late filing with good cause.

**Points of reading**

- No tier charges a filing fee: the fee is 0.00 USD throughout.
- The Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration is the only tier with a 3-day filing deadline; the other five tiers allow 90 days.
- Telephone filing is accepted on the Beneficiary Grievance and the Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration only; the other four tiers are opened in writing.
